chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Jaʿfar and ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn narrated from Abū al-Ḥasan Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام:

That they asked him about a man and a woman who dye themselves: may they perform salat while they are dyed with henna and wasmah? He said, “If they expose the mouth and the nostrils, then there is no problem.”

key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: there is no problem or objection

ai.seo_question: Can a man or woman perform salat while dyed with henna or wasmah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding performing salat while having dye such as henna or wasmah on the body. Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام states that there is no problem so long as the mouth and nostrils are left exposed.
